CLAIMS ceiling amendment (2026-08-31) — not a re-registration. CONFIRMATORY ClinicalTrials.gov query strings and Gate R/L/T/U rules are unchanged.

Scribe follows git studies/cannabis-safety/CLAIMS.md, not the original OSF paste:

(3) Quote Jynarque as metabolized almost exclusively by CYP3A. Do not write “sensitive CYP3A substrate” as a Jynarque label quote (that phrase is not on the DailyMed SPL). Hepatotoxicity boxed warning and REMS remain as on the label.

(5) CBD–tolvaptan is classified unstudied unless a dedicated pair PK/DDI study or a labeled named interaction is found at Units 01–04. Unit 00 is a source register only and does not classify the pair.
